exercise_name: What Makes You Beautiful · Listening & Vocabulary
description: 《What Makes You Beautiful》描寫一份充滿青春氣息、甜蜜與真誠欣賞的愛情。歌中的主角深深被一位女孩吸引，認為她的笑容、舉止與自然流露的魅力都令人心動。然而，女孩對自己缺乏信心，總是害羞地低下頭，甚至沒有察覺自己有多麼美麗。他希望透過歌曲讓她明白，無須依靠化妝或刻意改變外表，也能展現獨特的吸引力。女孩那份純真與不自覺的美麗，反而令她更加迷人。最終，《What Makes You Beautiful》傳達的是自信、純真與欣賞自我的重要：每個人都有獨特的美麗，無須迎合別人的標準，只要自然地展現真實的自己，便能散發令人心動的光芒。

vocabulary.meaning: 沒有安全感的；缺乏自信的
vocabulary.usage: 當一個人對自己的能力、外表或人際關係沒有信心時使用。
options: Before her first speech, Mia felt insecure about speaking in front of 200 people.
The city built an insecure bridge because it was very strong.
Our train arrived insecure at half past nine.
He insecure his ticket before entering the museum.
optionExplanations: 正確：insecure about 表示對公開演講感到沒有信心。
錯誤：橋樑很堅固應用 safe 或 strong；insecure 不表示堅固。
錯誤：這裡要描述火車到達的方式，insecure 不能直接這樣當副詞使用。
錯誤：insecure 是形容詞，不能直接當「檢查車票」的動詞。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：insecure about 表示對公開演講感到沒有信心。

vocabulary.meaning: 引人注目；讓人忍不住回頭看
vocabulary.usage: 當某人的外表、表演或特別的舉動吸引大家注意時使用。
options: The driver turned heads at the traffic light to make the car faster.
Her bright silver costume turned heads at the science fair.
I turned heads into my bag before the concert.
The librarian turned heads to tell everyone the library was closing.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：turn heads 在此不是讓汽車加速的方法。
正確：特別的服裝吸引了大家的目光。
錯誤：heads 不是能放進包包的物品，這樣不符合片語的意思。
錯誤：通知閉館可用 told everyone；turn heads 不表示通知。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：特別的服裝吸引了大家的目光。

vocabulary.usage: 可描述遮蓋東西，也可表示刻意隱瞞問題或錯誤。
options: The company tried to cover up its mistake, but the news reported it.
The coach covered up the score by winning the match.
We covered up to the airport at six.
My friend covered up a song on her guitar.
optionExplanations: 正確：cover up a mistake 表示隱瞞錯誤。
錯誤：贏得比賽不是遮蓋比數。
錯誤：去機場應說 went to the airport；cover up 不表示移動。
錯誤：演奏歌曲可以說 played a song；cover up 不是「翻唱」的標準說法。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：cover up a mistake 表示隱瞞錯誤。

vocabulary.meaning: 照亮；使某人露出開心的表情
vocabulary.usage: 可以描述燈光照亮空間，也可描述臉上突然出現笑容。
options: The bank lit up my money because I saved ten dollars.
Our guide lit up a bus ticket to learn its price.
I lit up my appointment by arriving early.
The empty stage lit up when the dancers turned on the lights.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：存錢不叫 light up；可說 the bank kept my money safe。
錯誤：查詢價格不是 light up 的意思。
錯誤：提早到達不會讓預約「亮起來」，搭配不自然。
正確：舞台因燈光而亮起。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：舞台因燈光而亮起。

vocabulary.meaning: 不知所措的；情緒太強烈而難以承受的
vocabulary.usage: 當事情太多，或情緒太強烈，讓人一下子難以應付時使用。
options: The singer felt overwhelmed when thousands of fans cheered her name.
I was overwhelmed because the lift went to the fifth floor.
The painter overwhelmed a pencil to draw a straight line.
The phone was overwhelmed blue because its screen was small.
optionExplanations: 正確：大量觀眾的歡呼讓歌手激動得難以承受。
錯誤：一般搭電梯上樓不會自然地表示「不知所措」，情境沒有交代強烈情緒。
錯誤：overwhelmed 不是畫線用的動詞。
錯誤：overwhelmed blue 的用法不自然，也不能用來表示螢幕小。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：大量觀眾的歡呼讓歌手激動得難以承受。

vocabulary.meaning: 很難判斷；不容易看出來
vocabulary.usage: 當資訊不足、不確定某件事的真相或結果時使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「It is hard to tell」？
options: It is hard to tell the meeting because it starts at noon.
It is hard to tell my suitcase when it weighs twelve kilos.
It is hard to tell who won because the race was so close.
It is hard to tell the door so I used a key.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：tell the meeting 不能表示「參加會議」。
錯誤：稱行李重量不說 tell my suitcase。
正確：比賽結果很接近，所以難以判斷誰贏。
錯誤：用鑰匙開門應說 unlock the door。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：比賽結果很接近，所以難以判斷誰贏。

vocabulary.meaning: 要是……就好了（表達願望或遺憾）
vocabulary.usage: 想像與現況不同的情況，尤其是希望現況能改變時使用。
options: If only the museum opens at nine every Saturday.
If only I can bought a ticket yesterday.
If only I had more time, I could learn to play the piano.
If only the bus is red, it will arrive tomorrow.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：單純陳述固定開放時間，不適合用 if only 表達願望。
錯誤：can bought 不是正確動詞結構；過去遺憾可說 If only I had bought a ticket。
正確：用 if only 加過去式，表達目前希望有更多時間。
錯誤：這是一般條件句的想法，應用 if；不是 if only 的願望語氣。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：用 if only 加過去式，表達目前希望有更多時間。

vocabulary.usage: 當一個人很急切地想得到某物、完成某事或獲得幫助時使用。
options: The artist desperately painted her canvas a light blue colour every Tuesday.
After losing his passport abroad, Ben desperately needed help.
We desperately arrived at the museum at exactly ten as planned.
She desperately her phone before the interview.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：只描述固定畫畫習慣，沒有迫切需要或強烈情緒。
正確：護照在國外遺失，急需幫助很符合 desperately 的意思。
錯誤：如期抵達不能自然地用 desperately 修飾。
錯誤：desperately 是副詞，不能直接當動詞。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：護照在國外遺失，急需幫助很符合 desperately 的意思。

vocabulary.meaning: 證明某人的看法是錯的
vocabulary.usage: 當別人不相信你能做到某事，而你以事實或結果反駁時使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「Prove someone wrong」？
options: He proved his neighbour wrong by asking the time.
The chef proved the menu wrong by putting it near the window.
We proved the weather wrong by taking an umbrella.
People said Ava could not finish the marathon, but she proved them wrong.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：詢問時間並未提供證據證明對方看法錯誤。
錯誤：放菜單的位置不能證明菜單「錯了」。
錯誤：帶傘不會直接證明天氣預報錯誤；應指明錯誤的預測和實際結果。
正確：Ava 完成馬拉松，證明別人的預測不對。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：Ava 完成馬拉松，證明別人的預測不對。

vocabulary.meaning: 轉過身去；拒絕讓某人進入
vocabulary.usage: 可指因害羞而把頭轉開，也可以指拒絕某人進入或參與。
options: The airport turned away my flight because I was excited.
The guard turned away visitors who did not have tickets.
She turned away her homework by writing every answer.
I turned away my favourite movie to watch it twice.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：不能用 turned away a flight 來表示乘客興奮。
正確：警衛拒絕沒有票的訪客入內。
錯誤：完成作業應用 finished；turn away 不是完成的意思。
錯誤：turn away 不是重看電影的意思。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：警衛拒絕沒有票的訪客入內。

structure.title: 句型研習
structure.note: 依提供的核對版材料編排；保留原有教學範圍。

questions.meaning: 用 be 描述主詞的狀態。
questions.usage: 描述目前的感受或特質；be 隨主詞改變。
questions.prompt: 演講前，哪句能正確描述 Ava 的緊張？
options: Ava is nervous before her speech.
Ava is nervously before her speech.
Ava are nervous before her speech.
optionExplanations: is + nervous 形成正確主詞與狀態。
nervously 是副詞，這裡需形容詞 nervous。
缺少 be 動詞 is。
單數 Ava 應配 is。
questions.example: insecure → confident / ready
questions.explanation: is + nervous 形成正確主詞與狀態。

questions.meaning: 歌詞省略 I，表示「不知道為了甚麼」。
questions.usage: 聊天、歌曲常省略清楚的主詞；正式書面句要補回。
questions.prompt: 朋友問你活動為何取消，哪一句最適合正式寫作？
options: I don't know why did they cancel the event.
I don't know why the event was canceled.
Don't knows why the event was canceled.
I don't know why was the event canceled.
optionExplanations: 間接問句不再用 did 倒裝。
完整主詞及間接問句語序都正確。
don’t 後接 know，不能 knows。
間接問句應用陳述語序。
questions.example: what for → why / where
questions.explanation: 完整主詞及間接問句語序都正確。

questions.word: 現在進行式：正在引人注意
questions.meaning: 表達當下正在發生的動作；turn heads 在此是「吸引目光」。
questions.usage: 描述目前台上的動作或正在引起的反應。
questions.prompt: 舞台上大家正看向舞者，哪句正確？
options: The dancer are turning heads with her new moves.
The dancer turning heads with her new moves.
The dancer is turn heads with her new moves.
The dancer is turning heads with her new moves.
optionExplanations: 單數 dancer 要用 is。
缺少 is。
進行式需 turning。
is + turning 構成現在進行式。
questions.example: turning heads → drawing attention
questions.explanation: is + turning 構成現在進行式。

questions.meaning: when 引出每當某事發生的時間情況。
questions.usage: 描述反覆發生的情境時，主句也可用一般現在式。
questions.prompt: 每當導覽員來，大家就安靜，哪句正確？
options: Everyone listens when arrives the guide.
Everyone listens when the guide arriving.
Everyone listens when the guide will arrive.
Everyone listens when the guide arrives.
optionExplanations: 一般從屬子句用主詞在動詞之前。
缺少限定動詞 arrives。
習慣描述的 when 子句不用 will。
when + guide arrives 是完整時間子句。
questions.cue: when you walk through the door
questions.example: you walk → she arrives
questions.explanation: when + guide arrives 是完整時間子句。

questions.meaning: need 後可直接接受詞名詞，不必加 to。
questions.usage: 說明不需要物品或資源；歌詞省略主詞 you。
questions.prompt: 已經有入場證，不需新票，哪句正確？
options: I don't need for another ticket.
I don't need to another ticket.
optionExplanations: need 直接接名詞，不必加 for。
need + another ticket 正確。
to 後不能直接接名詞作動詞。
don’t 後需原形 need。
questions.example: make-up → a ticket / more time
questions.explanation: need + another ticket 正確。

questions.meaning: to + 動詞原形可以回答「為了做甚麼」。
questions.usage: 解釋某個行動的目的；歌詞這行依賴前一句而非完整句。
questions.prompt: Mia 去圖書館是為了找資料，哪句正確？
options: Mia went to the library to find a map.
Mia went to the library for find a map.
Mia went to the library to finding a map.
Mia went to the library for to find a map.
optionExplanations: to find 說明去圖書館的目的。
for 後不能直接接原形 find。
to 後用原形 find。
這裡不需要 for to。
questions.example: cover up → save time / help others
questions.explanation: to find 說明去圖書館的目的。

questions.meaning: 一整個 V-ing 片語可以當句子主詞。
questions.usage: 談一個活動或生活方式「是……」時，搭配單數動詞 is。
questions.prompt: 說明每天閱讀很有幫助，哪句正確？
options: To reading every night is helpful.
optionExplanations: Reading every night 作主詞搭配 is。
不說 to reading，應用 Reading 或 To read。
整個動名詞片語視為單數，用 is。
原形 Read 不能直接這樣作活動名詞主詞。
questions.cue: Being the way that you are is enough
questions.example: Being yourself → Reading daily
questions.explanation: Reading every night 作主詞搭配 is。

questions.word: 關係子句 that 修飾名詞
questions.meaning: that 可引出形容前面名詞的關係子句。
questions.usage: 當你要補充是哪一個方法／物品時使用。
questions.prompt: 指出你昨天買的包，哪句正確？
options: This is the bag that I buying yesterday.
This is the bag that I bought yesterday.
This is the bag that bought I yesterday.
This is the bag that I bought it yesterday.
optionExplanations: 描述昨天發生的事應使用 bought。
that I bought yesterday 修飾 bag。
關係子句需正常主詞動詞語序。
關係代名詞已作 bought 的受詞，毋須 it。
questions.example: the way that you are → the bag that I bought
questions.explanation: that I bought yesterday 修飾 bag。

questions.meaning: everyone 是不定代名詞，常搭配第三人稱單數動詞。
questions.usage: 談「其他所有人」的共同行動時。
questions.prompt: 老師想說其他人都知道答案，哪句正確？
optionExplanations: else 不加 s。
everyone 搭配 knows。
句子缺少限定動詞。
everyone else + knows 正確。
questions.cue: Everyone else in the room can see it
questions.example: everyone else → everyone in the class
questions.explanation: everyone else + knows 正確。

questions.meaning: can 表能力或可能性，後面直接接原形動詞。
questions.usage: 談能不能做某事，毋須 to。
questions.prompt: 說明 Leo 會彈結他，哪句正確？
options: Leo can to play the guitar.
optionExplanations: can 後不接 playing。
can + play 是正確結構。
can 後不加 to。
情態動詞後不加第三人稱 s。
questions.example: see → help / swim
questions.explanation: can + play 是正確結構。

questions.meaning: like 表「像……一樣」，後面接名詞或代名詞。
questions.usage: 比較兩個人的表現或方式。
questions.prompt: 形容 Nina 唱歌像專業歌手，哪句正確？
options: Nina sings like to be a singer.
Nina sings like a professional singer.
Nina sings likes a professional singer.
optionExplanations: 這裡 professional 是形容詞，需補 a singer 或 a professional。
like 後不能直接接 to be 這種結構表比較。
like + a professional singer 很自然。
sings 後的比較介系詞應是 like。
questions.example: nobody else → her brother / a pro
questions.explanation: like + a professional singer 很自然。

questions.meaning: the way 加子句作「某人做事的方式」。
questions.usage: 以整個方式片語作主詞，後面再接句子的動詞。
questions.prompt: 畫家用顏色的方法讓觀眾開心，哪句正確？
options: The way does she use color makes people smile.
The way she uses color makes people smile.
The way she uses color make people smile.
The way she using color makes people smile.
optionExplanations: 嵌入子句不使用疑問倒裝。
The way she uses color 作主詞搭配 makes。
the way 子句作單數主詞，搭配 makes。
缺少限定動詞 uses。
questions.cue: The way that you flip your hair gets me overwhelmed
questions.example: you flip your hair → she paints
questions.explanation: The way she uses color 作主詞搭配 makes。

questions.meaning: get 可以表示使某人進入某種情緒狀態。
questions.usage: 描述事件引發人的驚喜、緊張或感動。
questions.prompt: 新消息讓全隊很興奮，哪句正確？
options: The good news got the team to excited.
The good news got the team excite.
The good news got excited the team.
The good news got the team excited.
optionExplanations: to 後不能直接接形容詞 excited。
受詞後要形容詞 excited。
正確語序為 get + 人 + excited。
got + the team + excited 完整。
questions.example: me overwhelmed → them excited
questions.explanation: got + the team + excited 完整。

questions.meaning: 歌詞 ain’t 是非正式否定形式；此處標準寫法為 isn’t。
questions.usage: 辨認歌曲口語，不應當成正式寫作的標準形式。
questions.prompt: 正式電郵表達「這不難理解」，哪句正確？
optionExplanations: hardly 是副詞，不能取代 hard。
hard 後接 to understand。
isn’t + hard + to understand 正確。
主詞 it 搭配 isn’t 而非 aren’t。
questions.example: hard to tell → easy to learn
questions.explanation: isn’t + hard + to understand 正確。

questions.word: know 後接省略 that 的子句
questions.meaning: know 後可直接接完整陳述子句，that 可省略。
questions.usage: 談知道或不知道一件事。
questions.prompt: 說自己知道表演明天開始，哪句正確？
options: I know the show start tomorrow.
I know the show to start tomorrow.
I know does the show start tomorrow.
I know the show starts tomorrow.
optionExplanations: 單數 show 一般現在式要 starts。
know 後此處需要子句，不是 to start。
間接內容不倒裝。
the show starts tomorrow 是完整子句。
questions.example: you are beautiful → the answer is right
questions.explanation: the show starts tomorrow 是完整子句。

questions.word: If only + 過去式表現在願望
questions.meaning: 用過去形式表達與現在不同的願望。
questions.usage: 希望現在情況改變，不代表事情真在過去。
questions.prompt: 希望自己現在有更多休息時間，哪句正確？
options: If only I had more free time!
If only I have more free time yesterday!
If only I will had more free time!
If only I having more free time!
optionExplanations: If only I had 表達現在的願望。
混用現在 have 與 yesterday；現況願望用 had。
will had 結構錯誤。
缺少限定動詞。
questions.cue: If only you saw what I can see
questions.example: you saw → I had / she knew
questions.explanation: If only I had 表達現在的願望。

questions.meaning: what 引出「……的東西／事情」，可作動詞受詞。
questions.usage: 不知道對方需要甚麼時可以用。
questions.prompt: 售票員想知道你需要甚麼，哪句正確？
options: Please tell me what you needs.
Please tell me what do you need.
Please tell me what you need.
Please tell me what need you.
optionExplanations: 主詞 you 搭配 need。
間接問句用陳述語序。
what you need 作 tell 的內容。
嵌入子句需主詞 you 在動詞前。
questions.example: what I can see → what you need
questions.explanation: what you need 作 tell 的內容。

questions.word: would + 原形動詞（虛擬結果）
questions.meaning: 此處 You’d = You would，承接 if only 的假設願望。
questions.usage: 表示若想像的條件成立，就可能得到某個結果。
questions.prompt: 假如有地圖，你就會找到路，哪句正確？
options: With a map, you would found the way.
With a map, you would find the way.
With a map, you would finding the way.
With a map, you would to find the way.
optionExplanations: would 後不直接用過去式 found。
would + find 正確。
would 後用原形 find。
would 後不加 to。
questions.cue: You'd understand why I want you so desperately
questions.example: understand → feel / know
questions.explanation: would + find 正確。

questions.meaning: why 子句可作 understand / know 等動詞的受詞。
questions.usage: 說明自己理解某個原因。
questions.prompt: 朋友解釋為甚麼早走，你終於明白，哪句正確？
options: I understand why she left early.
I understand why did she leave early.
I understand why she did left early.
I understand why left she early.
optionExplanations: why she left early 是正確間接問句。
間接問句不使用 did 倒裝。
did 後要原形 leave，這裡也無須 did。
應使用 she left 的陳述語序。
questions.example: I want you → she left early
questions.explanation: why she left early 是正確間接問句。

questions.word: 現在進行式與 right now
questions.meaning: right now 強調「此刻」正在進行的行動。
questions.usage: 說明現在立刻正在發生的事。
questions.prompt: 視像會議中說自己正在聽，哪句正確？
options: Right now, I'm listen to you.
Right now, I listening to you.
Right now, I'm listening to you.
Right now, I am listened to you.
optionExplanations: am 後需 listening。
進行式缺少 am。
am listening 正確表達正在聽。
listened 是過去分詞，並非此處進行式。
questions.cue: Right now I'm looking at you
questions.example: looking at you → waiting outside
questions.explanation: am listening 正確表達正在聽。

questions.meaning: what 可表示「……的事物／原因」，整個子句跟在 that is 後。
questions.usage: 指出真正重要或有價值的因素。
questions.prompt: 指出團隊互相合作是成功原因，哪句正確？
options: That's what makes our team strong.
That's what makes our team strongly.
That's what make our team strong.
That's what making our team strong.
optionExplanations: what makes our team strong 是完整子句。
make + 受詞 + 形容詞 strong，不用副詞 strongly。
what 在這裡作單數主詞，搭配 makes。
缺少完整限定動詞 makes。
questions.example: makes you beautiful → makes it special
questions.explanation: what makes our team strong 是完整子句。

questions.meaning: come on 可作鼓勵／催促的口語祈使表達；c- 是歌唱停頓。
questions.usage: 鼓勵朋友一起開始行動時。
questions.prompt: 朋友猶豫不敢參加遊戲，哪句最自然？
options: Comes on, let's give it a try!
Come on, let's give it a try!
Coming on, let's give it a try!
Come on to let's give it a try!
optionExplanations: 祈使語用原形 Come。
Come on 是自然的鼓勵語。
這裡直接鼓勵用 Come on。
come on 後不加 to 連接 let’s。
questions.example: come on → come here
questions.explanation: Come on 是自然的鼓勵語。

questions.word: get + 受詞 + 形容詞：判斷結果
questions.meaning: get it wrong 表「弄錯」；與造成情緒的 get + 受詞 + 形容詞不同語義。
questions.usage: 談答案、日期或理解出現錯誤時。
questions.prompt: 告訴朋友他記錯活動日期，哪句正確？
options: You got wrong the date; the trip is on Friday.
You got the date wrongly; the trip is on Friday.
You got the date to wrong; the trip is on Friday.
You got the date wrong; the trip is on Friday.
optionExplanations: get + 受詞 + 形容詞，不能把 wrong 放在受詞前。
用 wrong 作受詞補語，而非 wrongly。
to wrong 不是正確補語。
got + the date + wrong 表判斷錯誤。
questions.example: it wrong → the answer right
questions.explanation: got + the date + wrong 表判斷錯誤。

questions.word: to prove + 子句（省略 that）
questions.meaning: prove 後可以接完整 that 子句，that 可以省略。
questions.usage: 用實驗、證據說明某件事是真的。
questions.prompt: 學生想證明模型可用，哪句正確？
options: We did a test to prove does the model work.
We did a test to prove that works the model.
We did a test to prove the model works.
We did a test to prove the model working.
optionExplanations: prove 後的子句不用倒裝。
正常語序是 the model works。
prove 後接 the model works。
需用完整子句 the model works。
questions.example: I am right → the idea works
questions.explanation: prove 後接 the model works。

questions.word: put + 受詞 + in + 地點
questions.meaning: put 後需要放入的東西與位置，兩者要完整。
questions.usage: 說明把物品放在哪裡，也可比喻把心意寫進作品。
options: She put the brushes to a box.
She put in a box the brushes them.
She put the brushes in a box.
optionExplanations: 放入盒子應用 in。
重複受詞 them，且語序混亂。
put + brushes + in a box 正確。
缺少說明放在哪裡，情境未完整。
questions.cue: I put it in a song
questions.example: it in a song → the note in a box
questions.explanation: put + brushes + in a box 正確。

questions.word: be being + 形容詞：當下表現
questions.meaning: be being + 形容詞著重「目前表現得……」，不必代表永久個性。
questions.usage: 描述當下行為與平常可能不同時。
questions.prompt: 平常外向的 Ben 今天刻意安靜，哪句正確？
optionExplanations: is being quiet 表示當下的表現。
is 後需 being，不能直接 be。
being 後是形容詞 quiet，不是副詞 quietly。
缺少 is。
questions.example: being shy → being quiet / being kind
questions.explanation: is being quiet 表示當下的表現。

questions.meaning: turn away 可指轉身／轉頭避開；後面能接 when 時間子句。
questions.usage: 描述人在某個情況下把視線移開。
questions.prompt: Kai 怕強光，每當燈亮就轉頭，哪句正確？
options: Kai turns away when the light coming on.
Kai turn away when the light comes on.
Kai turns away when does the light come on.
Kai turns away when the light comes on.
optionExplanations: 需要限定動詞 comes。
單數 Kai 的一般現在式用 turns。
when 子句應用正常陳述語序。
turns away 與 when 子句都正確。
questions.cue: turn away when I look into your eye-eye-eyes
questions.example: when I look → when she speaks
questions.explanation: turns away 與 when 子句都正確。

questions.meaning: 此處 look into 是「望進眼睛」，不是自動表示「調查」。
questions.usage: 描述看進某處；不可把兩種語義混為一談。
questions.prompt: 孩子站在窗邊往房間裡看，哪句正確？
options: The child look into the room yesterday.
The child looked the room into through the window.
The child looked into the room through the window.
The child looked into to the room through the window.
optionExplanations: yesterday 需要過去式 looked。
look into 作搭配不能任意拆開。
looked into the room 自然描述視線方向。
into 本身已含方向，不再加 to。
questions.example: your eyes → the water / the room
questions.explanation: looked into the room 自然描述視線方向。

advanced.title: 進階字彙
advanced.note: 依提供的核對版材料編排；保留原有教學範圍。

questions.meaning: 為了什麼；為何（偏口語）
questions.usage: 詢問某件事的目的或原因；常接在簡短問句末尾。
options: He what for his lunch at twelve today.
I asked what the box was for before I opened it.
She went what for the library after school.
The ticket was what for because it was red.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：what for 不能直接當動詞使用；可說 ate his lunch。
正確：詢問盒子的用途，what ... for 表示「用來做什麼」。
錯誤：不能用 what for 取代去圖書館的動詞或介系詞。
錯誤：what for 不是形容詞，票券顏色也無法解釋用途。
questions.explanation: 正確：詢問盒子的用途，what ... for 表示「用來做什麼」。

questions.meaning: 走過、穿過某個空間
questions.usage: 表示從入口穿越房間、門或通道；也可延伸指逐步講解，但本題測試移動。
options: The children walked through the gate into the garden.
We walked through our lunch after the lesson.
She walked through happy because she got a gift.
I walked through to my new bag before school.
optionExplanations: 正確：從大門穿過進入花園，符合 walk through 的移動意思。
錯誤：午餐不是這裡可穿越的通道；若指吃午餐用 ate。
錯誤：happy 是形容詞，不能當作能穿越的空間。
錯誤：walk through 後需要合適的地點／對象；不能這樣接 to my bag。
questions.explanation: 正確：從大門穿過進入花園，符合 walk through 的移動意思。

questions.meaning: 化妝品（名詞；亦可寫 makeup）
questions.usage: 談化妝品或上妝時使用；put on make-up 表示化妝。
options: They made a make-up to close the window.
He put make-up over his homework to finish it.
The actor wore make-up for the school play.
She used make-up to take the bus home.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：make-up 在此是不可數的化妝品，不能說 made a make-up。
錯誤：化妝品不是完成作業的方法。
正確：演員為學校演出化妝，是自然的名詞用法。
錯誤：搭公車不需要用化妝品作為工具。
questions.explanation: 正確：演員為學校演出化妝，是自然的名詞用法。

questions.meaning: 足夠的；足夠地
questions.usage: 可放在名詞前（enough time），或放在形容詞後（warm enough）。
options: This bag is enough big for my books.
The team enough practiced before the game.
We have enough food for everyone at the party.
We have enough to chairs for the guests.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：修飾形容詞時放在後面，應說 big enough。
錯誤：enough 不能這樣放在動詞 practiced 前；可說 practiced enough。
正確：enough food 表示食物數量足夠所有人享用。
錯誤：enough 修飾複數名詞時不加 to；應說 enough chairs。
questions.explanation: 正確：enough food 表示食物數量足夠所有人享用。

questions.meaning: 其他所有人
questions.usage: 排除說話者或已指明的人後，指其餘每一個人；注意 everyone 搭配單數動詞。
options: Everyone else has a ticket, but I forgot mine.
Everyone else have finished the test already.
She everyone else to the station after class.
Everyone else are waiting inside the hall.
optionExplanations: 正確：除我以外的所有人都有票；everyone else 搭配 has。
錯誤：everyone else 視為單數，應搭配 has，不是 have。
錯誤：缺少主要動詞；everyone else 不是「帶人去」的動詞。
錯誤：everyone else 應搭配 is，不是 are。
questions.explanation: 正確：除我以外的所有人都有票；everyone else 搭配 has。

questions.meaning: 沒有其他人；別人都不……
questions.usage: 強調只有某人能做到或知道某事；nobody else 通常搭配單數動詞。
options: Nobody else knows the answer except our teacher.
I nobody else my friend after the class.
Nobody else have the same school key.
Nobody else are ready for the music show.
optionExplanations: 正確：除老師外沒人知道答案，符合排他含義與動詞 knows。
錯誤：nobody else 不是及物動詞，句子缺少主要動詞。
錯誤：nobody else 搭配 has，不是 have。
錯誤：nobody else 搭配單數 is，不是 are。
questions.explanation: 正確：除老師外沒人知道答案，符合排他含義與動詞 knows。

questions.meaning: 甩動／撥動頭髮
questions.usage: 描述快速甩髮、把頭髮撥到一側；使用時需有明確的頭髮動作。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「flip your hair」？
options: Please flip your hair into this glass of water.
She flipped her hair to open the locked door.
He flipped his hair to finish the math test.
She flipped her hair back before the photo.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：把頭髮甩進水杯並非此處自然的整理頭髮動作。
錯誤：甩頭髮無法代替用鑰匙開門。
錯誤：甩頭髮不是完成數學考試的方法。
正確：拍照前把頭髮往後一甩，是自然的動作描寫。
questions.explanation: 正確：拍照前把頭髮往後一甩，是自然的動作描寫。

questions.meaning: 弄錯了；理解錯誤（get it wrong 的過去式）
questions.usage: 表示答錯題目、聽錯資訊或誤解某事；it 指先前提到的內容。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「got it wrong」？
options: I got it wrong to the bus stop at six.
She got it wrong her shoes this morning.
They got it wrong because the wall was blue.
I guessed the date, but I got it wrong.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：got it wrong 不能用來表示前往公車站。
錯誤：不能用這個片語表示穿鞋或拿鞋。
錯誤：牆壁顏色不足以說明誤判了哪件事。
正確：猜錯日期，it 指猜測的日期。
questions.explanation: 正確：猜錯日期，it 指猜測的日期。

questions.meaning: 把某件心情或經驗寫進歌曲
questions.usage: 當歌曲包含一段經歷、想法或感受時使用；也可換成 put it in a letter。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「put it in a song」？
options: I put it in a song to turn off the classroom light.
She missed her old home, so she put it in a song.
He put it in a song to make the train arrive.
We put it in a song to cut the birthday cake.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：關教室電燈不會使用 put it in a song。
正確：她把想家的感受寫進歌曲，it 指前述心情。
錯誤：寫歌無法讓列車抵達；若要知道時間可查時刻表。
錯誤：切蛋糕不是把想法寫進歌曲的目的。
questions.explanation: 正確：她把想家的感受寫進歌曲，it 指前述心情。

questions.meaning: 表現得害羞；當下顯得靦腆
questions.usage: be + being + 形容詞 可強調某人暫時表現出某種態度；shy 也可直接作形容詞。
options: The chair is being shy because it is made of wood.
He is being shy the window before lunch.
She is being shy and will not look at the camera.
They are being shy to the library by bus.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：木製椅子不會有人的害羞表現。
錯誤：being shy 後不能直接接 window 當動作受詞。
正確：她暫時害羞得不敢看鏡頭，符合 being shy 的情境。
錯誤：being shy 不是搭車到圖書館的動詞片語。
questions.explanation: 正確：她暫時害羞得不敢看鏡頭，符合 being shy 的情境。

questions.meaning: 凝視……裡面；朝……內部看
questions.usage: 歌詞用於看進對方眼睛；另有「調查」的含義，但本題測試視線方向。
options: We looked into to the park on Sunday.
He looked into his friend’s eyes and smiled.
I looked into my lunch to eat it by six.
She looked into very happy at the show.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：look into 後不需再加 to，且此處想表達去公園。
正確：看著朋友的眼睛，符合 look into someone’s eyes。
錯誤：這裡想表達吃午餐，不需 look into。
錯誤：look into 後面不能直接接 very happy 作方向對象。
questions.explanation: 正確：看著朋友的眼睛，符合 look into someone’s eyes。

questions.meaning: 簡直不敢相信；難以置信
questions.usage: 遇到驚喜或非常意外的消息時使用；後面可接完整子句。
options: She can’t believe to the station on foot.
I can’t believe my homework with a pencil.
We can’t believe blue because it is Tuesday.
I can’t believe we won the game today!
optionExplanations: 錯誤：can’t believe 後面不能用 to the station 表達走路。
錯誤：這句想說用鉛筆寫作業，並非難以置信的內容。
錯誤：blue 是顏色詞，這樣接法不能表示不敢相信。
正確：贏得比賽令人驚喜，後接 we won the game 完整子句。
questions.explanation: 正確：贏得比賽令人驚喜，後接 we won the game 完整子句。
